_note: Stale readout windows, checked 2026-11-17 at David's ask ('correct any dates that are old or stale for readout window'). Each item was researched against the company's newest release / SEC filing / ClinicalTrials.gov record, then re-opened by an independent red-team pass (rt_verdict). apply_1117_stale_readouts.py applies only CONFIRMED / FIX items. Quotes are verbatim; '...' joins two exact fragments of the same page.

items.why: Row said 'Sponsor release 2026-09-22', but that release is the VK2735 maintenance-dosing study, not VANQUISH-2; the Q3 2026 window itself came from the 2026-04-29 release, which gives 3Q26 for the maintenance study only.
items.name: VANQUISH-1 and VANQUISH-2 Phase 3 (VK2735) completion
items.label: studies expected to be completed in 2027
items.quote: The company expects these studies to be completed in 2027.
items.rt_reason: Opened Viking's own Q3 2026 release on PR Newswire (dateline Oct. 28, 2026): 'The company expects these studies to be completed in 2027.' is verbatim and follows 'both VANQUISH studies continued to advance on track', so it covers VANQUISH-1 and -2; label 'studies expected to be completed in 2027' keeps the company's words.

items.why: Row (NCT06768671, VELA-TEEN, adolescent HS) was tagged with the IZAR-1 psoriatic-arthritis topline, a different trial.
items.name: sonelokimab VELA-TEEN (adolescent HS) final results
items.label: first quarter of 2027 (final results submitted for presentation)
items.quote: The Company expects to complete the VELA-TEEN clinical trial in the fourth quarter of 2026 ... plans to submit final results for presentation at a scientific conference in the first quarter of 2027
items.rt_reason: Opened MoonLake's Q3 release (Nov 4, 2026): both fragments are verbatim ('...complete the VELA-TEEN clinical trial in the fourth quarter of 2026' / '...plans to submit final results for presentation at a scientific conference in the first quarter of 2027'); the milestone bullet says the same. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06768671 is VELA-TEEN (adolescent HS); note the registry already shows COMPLETED, primary completion 2026-09-28 actual, while the company says Q4 2026.

items.rt_reason: Opened BioMarin's IR release dated May 20, 2026; headline verbatim. It covers CANOPY-HCH-3 (Study 111-303), and ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06455059 is acronym CANOPY-HCH-3, so it is the row's trial.

items.why: Row linked the conference-call notice for Study '304'; this row is the Phase 2 Study '207', whose results (female arms, Month 6) came 2026-07-15.
items.headline: Veradermics' Oral VDPHL01 Delivers Positive Study '207' Phase 2 Clinical Trial Results in Female Pattern Hair Loss
items.rt_reason: Opened the Business Wire release (Jul 15, 2026, per URL and FMP); the file's headline cuts off the page's headline, which continues 'Ahead of Upcoming Phase 2/3 Study ‘306’ Readout' (curly quotes). The trial matches NCT06527365 (open-label Phase 2, males and females, 12 months), but the release reports only female arms at Month 6; the Q3 release (Nov 10) gives no male or 12-month Study 207 results.

items.searched: Invivyd releases through the Q3 2026 release of 2026-11-16, which says DECLARATION data are 'to be available imminently'; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07298434
items.rt_reason: Opened Invivyd's Q3 release (Nov 16, 2026): 'DECLARATION Phase 3 clinical trial data on VYD2311 (ibramvibart) to be available imminently'. It reports no DECLARATION results (only LIBERTY). The FMP press-release and news lists through Nov 17 and a web search show no DECLARATION results release. NCT07298434 is DECLARATION.

items.why: Company guided BDC-4182 initial data with its Q3 2026 results; the Q3 release (2026-11-12) has none.
items.searched: Bolt releases through the Q3 2026 release of 2026-11-12 and the Q3 10-Q
items.rt_reason: Q2 release (Aug 11, 2026) said BDC-4182 initial data were 'expected to be released with Bolt's 3Q 2026 results'. Opened the Q3 release (Nov 12, 2026): BDC-4182 appears only as 'a claudin 18.2-targeting Boltbody™ ISAC', with no data or timing. FMP press releases and news through Nov 17 show nothing later.

items.why: Phase 3 HERO was terminated early; only exploratory data were released.
items.quote: The HERO trial randomized 67 of the planned 90 participants and was terminated early.
items.rt_reason: Opened Aardvark's release (Oct 23, 2026), 'Aardvark Therapeutics Reports Exploratory Data from the Terminated HERO and Open-Label Extension Trials': 'The HERO trial randomized 67 of the planned 90 participants and was terminated early.' is verbatim. HERO is the ARD-101 Phase 3 study, the row's program.

items.why: NCT06079190 is PROGRESS-AD of AL101 (nivisnebart), not AL001; the company discontinued it after an interim futility analysis.
items.name: nivisnebart (AL101) PROGRESS-AD
items.quote: Alector to Discontinue Phase 2 PROGRESS-AD Trial of Nivisnebart (AL101/GSK4527226) in Early Alzheimer's Disease Following Interim Futility Analysis
items.rt_reason: Opened Alector's release (Apr 29, 2026); the headline matches the quote (the page uses a curly apostrophe in Alzheimer’s). ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06079190 is PROGRESS-AD of GSK4527226 [AL101] (GSK sponsor, Alector collaborator), TERMINATED, so the name fix to nivisnebart (AL101) is right.

items.why: FLASH2 halted for futility at the interim analysis.
items.quote: Under the terms of the interim analysis, the study was recommended to halt for futility.
items.rt_reason: Opened Soligenix's PR Newswire release (Apr 28, 2026) on the FLASH2 interim results: 'Under the terms of the interim analysis, the study was recommended to halt for futility.' is verbatim. NCT06470451 is FLASH2 (HyBryte/hypericin, CTCL), TERMINATED.

items.why: KOURAGE enrollment paused; the company does not plan to restart it.

items.rt_reason: Opened CalciMedica's Q3 release (Nov 10, 2026): 'CalciMedica does not plan to restart KOURAGE at this time.' is verbatim; enrollment was paused in January 2026. NCT06374797 is KOURAGE (Auxora/zegocractin, AKI with respiratory failure), TERMINATED.
